text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Passing the "GATE." Perhaps that was 
achieved at the end of summer. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It won't truly be set in stone until we 
take our first step onto the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe takes a step 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Upon the "lunar surface," where no one had 
ever set foot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Placing both hands gently on her back... I 
warmly sent her on her way.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira... huh.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This single step is a small one. But—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's a "singularity." Of Neo Universe and 
the others...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The end of a journey. And—a beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here, Neo Universe's new course 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san, it's finally time. The first leg 
of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of giving up the lead 
role. However, I also know that nothing is 
set in stone yet.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy. Neo Universe cherishes... 
you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to gain altitude and achieve 
"separation" to stage 2 together...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"And that is precisely why it might 
obstruct it. The interstellar route, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
They could become an obstacle blocking the 
path ahead. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What I want to chronicle is—the most 
passionate heroic epic...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even if one manages to become a hero, it 
is meaningless if it does not stir the 
reader's heart."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Books are always there to inspire me when 
I want to change who I am. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—Please, Uni-san. Let's weave a new story 
together, the two of us!”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative. Going... now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reborn cosmic girl and the awakened 
hero. This is—an as-yet-unseen Chapter 2.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stories collide, bringing forth a new 
history.
